1. (Currently amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said alignment device comprises a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium to perform said computing, and wherein said alignment is computed by analyzing temporal sequences of the demonstrated user actions and comparing them to temporal sequences of the document actions.

2. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment by determining which step in a sequence of steps has the highest alignment score relative to the demonstrated user actions performed up to a present time.

3. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, and wherein the highlighting is performed in real-time as the demonstrated user actions are being performed.

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification, wherein the highlighting distinguishes the current step from other steps in the documented procedure through visual differentiation.

5. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment by predicting, based on the temporal sequence of demonstrated user actions, which step should be performed subsequent to the current step.

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, and wherein the highlighting is performed in anticipation of the user performing the next step.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification, wherein the highlighting of the next step is visually distinct from the highlighting of the current step.

9. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, and wherein said similarity metric further comprises a measure of temporal alignment between when the common strings are accessed in the user interface and when they are referenced in the documented procedure.

10. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment by extracting action features from the captured images and comparing them to action features specified in the documented procedure.

11. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and wherein said previous user experiences are stored in a database and used to weight the similarity metric based on historical patterns of user behavior.

12. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, wherein the document action extractor parses the documented procedure to identify discrete action steps and their sequential ordering.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said alignment device comprises a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, wherein the scrolling is performed in response to detection of completion of a current step based on the alignment.

14. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein the alignment device further computes the alignment by analyzing temporal sequences and action types of the demonstrated user actions relative to the documented procedure steps.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment by extracting visual features from the captured images and comparing them to visual features specified in the documented procedure.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and wherein said previous user experiences inform weighting of the similarity metric.

17. (Currently amended) A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said computing step comprises analyzing temporal sequences of the demonstrated user actions and comparing them to temporal sequences of the document actions using a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment by determining which step in a sequence of steps has the highest alignment score relative to the demonstrated user actions performed up to a present time.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface in real-time as the demonstrated user actions are being performed.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment by predicting, based on the temporal sequence of demonstrated user actions, which step should be performed subsequent to the current step.

21. (Currently amended) The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface in anticipation of the user performing the next step.

23. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, and wherein said similarity metric further comprises a measure of temporal alignment between when the common strings are accessed in the user interface and when they are referenced in the documented procedure.

24. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, by extracting action features from the captured images and comparing them to action features specified in the documented procedure.

25. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, wherein said previous user experiences are used to weight the similarity metric based on historical patterns of user behavior.

26. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure by parsing the documented procedure to identify discrete action steps and their sequential ordering.

27. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions as recited in claim 17, wherein the program instructions, when executed, cause the machine to analyze temporal sequences of demonstrated user actions and compare them to temporal sequences of document actions.

28. (Currently amended) A method for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the method comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said computing step comprises analyzing temporal sequences of the demonstrated user actions and comparing them to temporal sequences of the document actions using a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium; visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment; and automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment in response to detection of completion of a current step.

29. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein the alignment is computed by analyzing action types and temporal sequences of the demonstrated user actions relative to the documented procedure steps.

30. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, by extracting visual features from the captured images and comparing them to visual features specified in the documented procedure.

31. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, wherein said previous user experiences inform weighting of the similarity metric.

32. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface as recited in claim 28, wherein the program instructions, when executed, cause the machine to analyze temporal sequences of demonstrated user actions and compare them to temporal sequences of document actions.
